facts.text: After independence the Industrial Finance Corporation of India was established in 1948 to make available long term loans to industrial projects.
facts.quote: After India became independent, the Industrial Finance Corporation of India was established in 1948 with the purpose of making available long term loans to industrial projects.

facts.text: The Industrial Development Corporation was established in 1954 to bring about greater development of the industrial sector.
facts.quote: Similarly the Industrial Development Corporation was established in 1954 in order to bring about greater development of the industrial sector.

facts.text: The textile industry includes the powerloom and the handloom industries; the handloom industries are labour intensive.
facts.quote: It includes the powerloom and the handloom industries. The handloom industries are labour intensive.

facts.text: According to the 'Textile Committee Act 1963' a Textile Committee was established; it sets quality standards for textiles for the internal market and for export.
facts.quote: According to the 'Textile Committee Act 1963', a Textile Committee has been established. This committee sets the quality standards for textiles manufactured for sale in the internal market as well as for export.

facts.text: The silk industry functions under the Ministry of Textiles; research on silkworm species and mulberry trees is done in the Seribiotic Research Laboratory at Bengaluru.
facts.quote: This industry functions under the Ministry of Textiles. The research about the species of the silkworm and mulberry trees is done in the Seribiotic Research Laboratory at Bengaluru.

facts.text: The silk industry is primarily in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal and Jammu and Kashmir, and is now spreading to States with predominantly tribal populations.
facts.quote: This industry is primarily in the States of Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal and Jammu and Kashmir. Now it is being spread in States with predominantly tribal populations.

facts.text: India is a major exporter of jute products; we get cloth, sack cloth and ropes from jute.
facts.quote: India is a major exporter of jute products. We get cloth, sack cloth and ropes from jute.

facts.text: 'Mega cluster' is a scheme that helps weavers through self-finance groups and non-governmental organisations, with raw material, design banks, technology and welfare.
facts.quote: 'Mega cluster' is a scheme that helps weavers through self-finance groups and non-governmental organisations. Help is given in the form of raw material, design banks, development of technology and welfare of the weavers.

facts.text: Hand sculpting is a labour intensive craft that absorbs more craftsmen with small investment; market mechanisms like 'Dilli Haat' give craftsmen a market for their wares.
facts.quote: This is a labour intensive craft. Sculptors got employment due to the capacity of the craft to absorb more craftsmen, small investment, more profits, preference to exports ... Several cities have market mechanisms like 'Dilli Haat' which enables the craftsmen from rural and urban areas to get a market for their wares.

facts.text: The automobile industry is called the 'sunrise sector' in India.
facts.quote: The automobile industry is called the 'sunrise sector' in India.

facts.text: Tractors manufactured in India are exported to Turkey, Malaysia and several countries in Africa.
facts.quote: Tractors manufactured in India are exported to Turkey, Malaysia and several countries in Africa.

facts.text: The cement industry is important for housing and infrastructure and is one of the most technologically advanced industries.
facts.quote: The role of cement industry is important in the development of housing and infrastructure. This industry is one of the most technologically advanced.

facts.text: The leather industry is a big industry in India and is primarily export oriented.
facts.quote: It is a big industry in India. It is primarily export oriented.

facts.text: Bicycles are made in Punjab and Tamil Nadu; the main centre of bicycle manufacturing in India is Ludhiana; bicycles are exported to countries like Nigeria, Mexico, Kenya, Uganda and Brazil.
facts.quote: Bicycles are made in the States of Punjab and Tamil Nadu. The main centre of bicycle manufacturing in India is Ludhiana. India exports bicycles to countries like Nigeria, Mexico, Kenya, Uganda and Brazil.

facts.text: The Khadi and Village Industries Commission gives impetus to industrialisation in rural areas, develops traditional industries, handicrafts and cottage industries, and aims to make villages self-reliant by creating employment.
facts.quote: The Khadi and Village Industries Commission was established to give impetus to industrialisation in rural areas. The main objectives ... were to develop the traditional industries, handicrafts, cottage industries ... and make the villages self-reliant by creating employment there.

facts.text: Agriculture uses traditional and modern methods: many tasks are done using bullocks, and machines are used for ploughing, sowing, harvesting and threshing.
facts.quote: In India, agriculture is practised using traditional and modern methods. Many agricultural tasks are performed using bullocks. Similarly, machines are being used in different tasks like ploughing, sowing to harvesting, threshing, etc.

facts.text: In agriculture the participation of women is equal to that of men.
facts.quote: In this industry the participation of women is equal to that of men.

facts.text: Jowar, wheat, rice, pulses and oilseeds are mainly produced; cotton and sugarcane are processed to manufacture cloth and sugar respectively.
facts.quote: Jowar, wheat, rice, pulses and oilseeds are mainly produced. Along with it, cotton and sugarcane are processed to manufacture cloth and sugar respectively.

facts.text: Loans are given to farmers through rural banks and cooperative institutions; study visits and farmers' get-togethers are organised through the Panchayat Samitis.
facts.quote: In order to encourage farming, loans are given to farmers through rural banks and cooperative institutions. Study visits, agricultural outdoor trips and farmers' get-togethers are organised through the Panchayat Samitis to bring about improvements in agriculture.

facts.text: Farmers get training in soil testing, pisciculture, poultry, dairy farming, etc.; guidance comes from a district level training institute; financial help is given to build warehouses.
facts.quote: The farmers are given training regarding soil testing, nursery of fruit plants, pisciculture, poultry, cattle and goat rearing, dairy farming, etc. Guidance is given to farmers by a district level training institute. Financial help is given to build warehouses for storing the farm produce.

facts.text: Modern techniques like drip irrigation and organic farming are used for farming.
facts.quote: Modern techniques like drip irrigation, organic farming are used for farming.

facts.text: In the fourth five year plan, focus was placed on paper, pharmaceutical, motor-tractor, leather goods, textile, food processing, oil, colour and sugar industries, etc.
facts.quote: In the fourth five year plan, focus was placed on paper industry, pharmaceutical industry, motor-tractor industry, leather goods, textile industry, food processing industry, oil, colour, sugar industries, etc.

facts.text: Under the Industrial Licensing Policy of 1970, factories requiring an investment of more than 5 crore rupees were heavy industries; big industrial houses and foreign companies could invest in heavy industries not reserved for the public sector.
facts.quote: According to the Industrial Licensing Policy of 1970, all those factories requiring an investment of more than 5 crore rupees were to be included as heavy industries. The big industrial houses and foreign companies were allowed to invest in heavy industries that were not reserved for the public sector.

facts.text: As a result of this policy, by the end of 1972, 3 lakh 18 thousand small industries were registered with the government registration office.
facts.quote: As a result of this policy, by the end of 1972, 3 lakh 18 thousand small industries were registered with the government registration office.

facts.text: The availability of minerals, iron and coal plays a major role in industrial development; India has adequate stores of iron, manganese, coal and mineral oil.
facts.quote: The availability of the minerals, iron and coal plays a major role in the industrial development of the country. We have adequate stores of iron, manganese, coal and mineral oil in our country.

facts.text: Government has reserved some forests for forest-based industries; conservation is done by the central government, the State government and the local people.
facts.quote: Government has reserved some forests for the industries based on forests. The task of conservation of the forests is done by the central government, the State government and by the local people.

facts.text: Forests give raw material for industries like construction, paper, newsprint, silk, matchboxes, medicinal herbs, honey, lacquer and paint.
facts.quote: Forests are necessary for the raw material for industries like construction, paper, newsprint, silk, matchboxes, medicinal herbs, honey, lacquer and raw material needed for paint.

facts.text: Fisheries include sea water fish and fresh water fish; harbours, fish seed incubation centres and fishing industry training centres have been provided.
facts.quote: Fisheries include sea water fish and fresh water fish found in rivers, canals, ponds and lakes. Harbours have been built or old harbours have been redeveloped, fish seed incubation centres and fishing industry training centres have been provided for the growth of this industry.

facts.text: Tourists travel in India throughout the year; facilities are provided through the Tourism Development Corporation; sale of curios and the hotel industry thrive in tourist places.
facts.quote: Tourists from our country as well as from abroad travel in India throughout the year. The facilities for tourists to stay, travel, etc. are provided through the Tourism Development Corporation. Sale of curios and the hotel industry thrives in tourist places.

facts.text: Guides, and local people who help tourists reach remote places in return for a fee, show how tourism generates employment.
facts.quote: In some places, there are guides who give information to tourists about that area. Sometimes when vehicles don't reach the destination in some remote and difficult to reach tourist places, the local people help the tourists in return for a fee. Employment opportunities are generated out of these needs.

facts.text: When planning started in 1951, imports increased; India's imports included machines, iron, mineral oil, fertilisers, medicines, etc.
facts.quote: When planning started in 1951, the import of industrial goods and raw material required for production increased, India's imports included machines, iron, mineral oil, fertilisers, medicines, etc.

facts.text: India gave impetus to exports after independence to gain valuable foreign exchange; exports included tea, coffee, spices, cotton textiles, leather, footwear, pearls, precious stones, etc.
facts.quote: India also gave impetus to exports after independence in order to gain valuable foreign exchange. India's exports included tea, coffee, spices, cotton textiles, leather, footwear, pearls, precious stones, etc.

facts.text: India's internal trade takes place via railways, waterways, roads and airways; ports like Mumbai, Kolkata, Cochi and Chennai are important.
facts.quote: India's internal trade takes place via railways, waterways, roads, airways, etc. Ports like Mumbai, Kolkata, Cochi and Chennai are important.

facts.text: Due to the development of industries, the standard of life improves and many opportunities for employment become available.
facts.quote: Due to the development of industries, the standard of life in the country improves. Many opportunities for employment become available.
